They are very kind and professional, I can only recommend them :) (y)
We have been going to Dorottya for years, I love the way she takes care of our puppy and her fur is always perfect. I can only recommend them❤️

I can only recommend Dorottya Kutyakozmetika and Dóri's team! :)

I went to them for the dog grooming training, and I can say with all my heart that I would choose them again anytime, because for me it was the best possible place to learn.

The professional training was of a very high standard, there is a lot to learn, and the theoretical education is also completely fine. What was equally important to me was that the team is incredibly welcoming, helpful and good-natured. 😊

What really makes this place stand out is that the dogs really come first here. Their safety is above all else. Hygiene, the environment and occupational health and safety rules also serve this to the fullest. There are strict rules that must be followed, but completely understandable, since everything is done in the best interests of the dogs.

So, for anyone thinking about taking the dog grooming course, I can really only say: go to Dóri and his team! 🐶✂️❤️
Matyi's hairstyle is done by little Dorottya❤️❤️❤️❤️❤️ wonderfully!

My puppy (toy poodle) is 4.5 months old. He just had his first real grooming. He spent 3 hours here so that everything would happen at his pace and not have a bad experience - they absolutely did that. I took over a happy puppy after the grooming, who turned out to be beautiful, I can only recommend it! 😊 …
